docs.text: MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT dated 2026-03-01 between Meridian Precision Robotics GmbH (hereinafter 'MPR' or 'CLIENT'), having offices at Technologiestrasse 14, 80992 Munich, Germany, and Northstar Strategic Advisory LLC ('ADVISOR'). Contact: Dr. Elena Vance (elena.vance@meridian-robotics.de). Under Clause 14.1, MPR's aggregate liability cap shall not exceed USD $1,850,000.00 (1.5x Annual Fees), excluding breaches of confidentiality under Clause 9.3. Project Obsidian milestones are governed by Schedule A. Wire instructions: IBAN DE89370400440532013000 at First National Bank of Delaware.

DATA PROCESSING ADDENDUM incorporating terms of the MSA with Meridian Precsion Robotics GmbH and its wholly-owned subsidiary Meridian Robotics US Inc. ('Sub-Processor Affiliate'). Apex Biologics GmbH acts as an independent clinical data auditor (distinct from Zenith Biologics GmbH). Controller notices to Meridian shall copy legal@meridian-robotics.de and Dr. Elena Vance.

CONFIDENTIAL ACQUISITION LETTER OF INTENT: Operation Falcon (the proposed acquisition of Meridian Precision Holdings AG and operating subsidiary MPR by Zenith Biologics GmbH, 'BUYER'). Escrow agent: Second National Bank of Delaware. Northstar advises Target; excluding Project Obsidian IP.

SCHEDULE B SUPPLIER PRICING: Meridian Precision Robotics GmbH ('VENDOR') supplies robotics actuators to Zenith Biologics GmbH ('CLIENT'). Apex Biologics GmbH provides calibration testing. Payments wire to First National Bank of Delaware.

JOINDER AGREEMENT: Northstar Strategic Advisory LLC ('CLIENT') retains Meridian Precision Robotics GmbH ('VENDOR') for robotics prototyping under Operation Falcon. Elena Vance signs for VENDOR; Marcus Thorne signs for CLIENT.

MUTUAL NDA between Northstar Strategic Advisory LLC ('DISCLOSING_PARTY') and Zenith Biologics GmbH ('RECEIVING_PARTY'), excluding information independently developed by Apex Biologics GmbH. Meridian Robotics US Inc. operates separately from Second National Bank of Delaware.
